name: Drop Zone
author: Carlos Granier
description: A drop zone in the bar: drag or paste files onto it from anywhere, as many times as you like, then deliver them all at once: copy, move or zip into a folder, or send them to an SSH host.

barWidget.description: Stages file locations dropped or pasted on it. Drag the zone into a folder, press the target to choose one, or send to an SSH host, to copy, move or zip them all at once. Nothing is touched until you deliver.

schema.label: Keep files on the shelf after copying
schema.description: Off: a successful copy clears the copied items from the shelf. On: they stay, so you can deliver the same set to another folder. Moves always clear.

schema.label: Notify when a delivery finishes
schema.description: A notification saying how many items were delivered, with an Open folder button for local folders. Failures always notify.

schema.label: SSH hosts offered
schema.description: Comma-separated SSH aliases to offer under Send to host. Empty offers every concrete Host in ~/.ssh/config except git-only ones (User git). Hosts need sh, tar and mv (Linux or macOS).
